title: DAMAGE NUMBERS ARE A SETTING
why: His answer 33: the damage numbers become a Settings row, on by default. The numbers that float off a target when you hit it (and the red ones over you that your teammate sees) have been on since v8.35 under a dial you could not reach. That dial is now a row in DISPLAY, DAMAGE NUMBERS, ON by default, so the game looks exactly as it did, and OFF takes every number off the screen. The damage itself is untouched.
now: Settings has a DAMAGE NUMBERS row in DISPLAY, ON by default. Turn it off to hide the numbers.
